title: The MCP test harness deadlocks when the server's replies fill the stdout pipe before all frames are written
body:
The same write-all-then-read session was hand-rolled in five other tests: mcp_stdio_serves.rs, the_mcp_organize_door_answers_in_project_relative_paths.rs, wb_archive_message.rs, no_removal_is_unannounced.rs, and a sed feed in migrated_guards_still_refuse.rs. Each could hang the same way when its replies were large.

Follow-up done (hv decision 90, rides 3.5.2), bank refs/bank/cc/ci352/v5 = 0f4636480: the four MCP sessions now go through mcp_session, and the sed feed runs on its own thread.
